title: hamiltonians-phase-space-cell widget params
description: Bespoke widget for the §1 phase-space cell on the hamiltonians-classical-mechanics topic. Renders an SVG host plus two action buttons (play/reset) and a readout reporting the cell's area, centroid, and shape. The buttons-only gesture (no sliders, no select) doesn't fit any shared slug; this slug captures it as a single unit and carries the bespoke draw logic in the bodyScript artifact.

svgId.description: DOM id for the host <svg> element.

outputId.description: DOM id for the <div class="readout"> companion.

ariaLabel.description: aria-label attribute on the <svg>. The source uses aria-label rather than an internal <title> child — preserved verbatim for byte-identity.

buttons.description: Action buttons rendered inside a single .row.

outputInitial.description: Initial inner HTML of the readout <div>.

sectionComment.description: ARTIFACT. Optional /* ... */ comment placed between the leading <script> tag and the IIFE opener.

bodyScript.x-artifact: script body is bespoke; portable consumers should implement their own draw + Liouville-flow integrator from {buttons, ariaLabel} alone
bodyScript.description: ARTIFACT. Verbatim JS statements that go inside `(function(){\n…\n})();` — sets up the SVG, draws the cell, integrates harmonic-oscillator flow on the play button, and writes area/centroid to the readout.

widgetId.description: DOM id for the outer <div class="widget">. Required by the corpus-wide test-widget-renderers convention.
